<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(e)</font><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font>&#8220;Compliance Certificate&#8221; has the meaning set forth in Section 15(a).</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(f)</font><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font>&#8220;Date of Grant&#8221; has the meaning set forth in the preamble.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(g)</font><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font>&#8220;Date of Termination&#8221; means the first day occurring on or after the Date of Grant on which the Participant is not employed by the Company, a Subsidiary, or an Affiliated Entity, regardless of the reason for the termination of employment; provided, however, that a termination of employment shall not be deemed to occur by reason of a transfer of the Participant between the Company, a Subsidiary, and an Affiliated Entity or between two Subsidiaries or two Affiliated Entities.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Participant&#8217;s employment shall not be considered terminated while the Participant is on a leave of absence from the Company, a Subsidiary, or an Affiliated Entity approved by the Participant&#8217;s employer pursuant to Company policies.&nbsp;&nbsp;If, as a result of a sale or other transaction, the Participant&#8217;s employer ceases to be either a Subsidiary or an Affiliated Entity, and the Participant is not, at the end of the 30-day period following the transaction, employed by the Company or an entity that is then a Subsidiary or Affiliated Entity, then the date of occurrence of such transaction shall be treated as the Participant&#8217;s Date of Termination.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(h)</font><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font>&#8220;Early Retirement Date&#8221; means, with respect to the Participant, the first day of a month that occurs on or after the date the Participant (i) attains age 55 and (ii) earns at least 10 Years of Service.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(i)</font><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font> &#8220;Installment&#8221; has the meaning set forth in Section 15(a).</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(j)</font><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font>&#8220;Non-Compliance Event&#8221; has the meaning set forth in Section 15(b).</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(k)</font><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font>&#8220;Non-Disclosure Agreement&#8221; has the meaning set forth in Section 15(a).</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(l)</font><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font>&#8220;Normal Retirement Date&#8221; means, with respect to the Participant, the first day of a month that occurs on or after the date the Participant attains age 65.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(m)</font><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font>&#8220;Participant&#8221; has the meaning set forth in the preamble.</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(o)</font><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font>&#8220;Post-Retirement Vesting Eligible&#8221; means the Participant&#8217;s Date of Termination occurs (i) by reason of the Participant&#8217;s retirement and (ii) on or after the earlier of the Participant&#8217;s Early Retirement Date or the Participant&#8217;s Normal Retirement Date, provided that, in connection with the Participant&#8217;s termination of employment, the Committee has not otherwise affirmatively determined that the Participant shall not be Post-Retirement Vesting Eligible.</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;letter-spacing:-0.15pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;COMPANY&#8221;<font style="margin-left:216pt;"></font>DEVON ENERGY CORPORATION</p>

<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:18pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">EXHIBIT A</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Form of Non-Disclosure Agreement</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:18pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">[Insert Date]</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Devon Energy Corporation</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">333 West Sheridan Avenue</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Oklahoma City, OK 73102-5015</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Re:&nbsp;&nbsp;Non-Disclosure Agreement</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Ladies and Gentlemen:</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-right:7.69%;text-indent:7.69%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">This letter agreement is entered between Devon Energy Corporation (together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, the &#8220;Company&#8221;) and the undersigned (the &#8220;Participant&#8221;) in connection with that certain Restricted Stock Award Agreement (the &#8220;Agreement&#8221;) dated _______________, 20___ between the Company and the Participant.&nbsp;&nbsp;All capitalized terms used in this letter agreement shall have the same meaning ascribed to them in the Agreement unless specifically denoted otherwise.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-right:7.69%;text-indent:7.69%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;letter-spacing:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_C133"></a><a name="_DV_X75"></a><a name="_DV_C134"></a><a name="_DV_C135"></a><a name="_DV_X77"></a><a name="_DV_C136"></a><a name="_DV_C137"></a><a name="_DV_X79"></a><a name="_DV_C138"></a><a name="_DV_C139"></a><a name="_DV_X81"></a><a name="_DV_C140"></a><a name="_DV_C141"></a><a name="_DV_X83"></a><a name="_DV_C142"></a><a name="_DV_X85"></a><a name="_DV_C143"></a><font style="text-decoration:none;"><a name="_DV_X75"></a><a name="_DV_C134"></a>The Participant acknowledges that, during<a name="_DV_C135"></a> the course of and in connection with <a name="_DV_X77"></a><a name="_DV_C136"></a>the<a name="_DV_C137"></a> employment relationship <a name="_DV_X79"></a><a name="_DV_C138"></a>between the Participant and the Company, the Company provided and the Participant accepted access to<a name="_DV_C139"></a> the Company&#8217;s trade secrets and confidential and proprietary information, which <a name="_DV_X81"></a><a name="_DV_C140"></a>included<a name="_DV_C141"></a>, without limitation, information pertaining to the Company&#8217;s finances, oil and gas properties and prospects, compensation structures, business and litigation strategies and future business plans and other information or material that is of special and unique value to the Company and that the Company maintains as confidential and does not disclose to the general public<a name="_DV_X83"></a><a name="_DV_C142"></a>, <a name="_DV_X85"></a><a name="_DV_C143"></a>whether through its annual report and/or filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission or otherwise (the &#8220;Confidential Information&#8221;).</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-right:7.69%;text-indent:7.69%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;letter-spacing:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_DV_X87"></a><a name="_DV_C144"></a><a name="_DV_C145"></a><a name="_DV_X89"></a><a name="_DV_C146"></a><a name="_DV_C147"></a><a name="_DV_X91"></a><a name="_DV_C148"></a><a name="_DV_C149"></a><a name="_DV_X93"></a><a name="_DV_C150"></a><a name="_DV_X95"></a><a name="_DV_C151"></a><a name="_DV_C152"></a><a name="_DV_X97"></a><a name="_DV_C153"></a><a name="_DV_X99"></a><a name="_DV_C154"></a><a name="_DV_C155"></a><font style="text-decoration:none;"><a name="_DV_C145"></a>The Participant <a name="_DV_X89"></a><a name="_DV_C146"></a>acknowledges<a name="_DV_C147"></a> that his position with the Company<a name="_DV_X91"></a><a name="_DV_C148"></a> was<a name="_DV_C149"></a> one of trust and confidence because of the access to <a name="_DV_X93"></a><a name="_DV_C150"></a>the<a name="_DV_X95"></a><a name="_DV_C151"></a> Confidential Information, requiring the Participant&#8217;s best efforts and utmost diligence to protect and maintain the confidentiality of the Confidential Information.&nbsp;&nbsp;Unless required by the Company <a name="_DV_C152"></a>or with the Company&#8217;s express written consent, the Participant will not, <a name="_DV_X97"></a><a name="_DV_C153"></a>during the term of this letter agreement<a name="_DV_X99"></a><a name="_DV_C154"></a>, directly or indirectly, disclose to others or use for his own benefit or the benefit of another any of the <a name="_DV_C155"></a>Confidential Information, whether or not the Confidential Information is acquired, learned, attained or developed by the Participant alone or in conjunction with others.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-right:7.69%;text-indent:7.69%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Participant agrees that, due to his access to the Confidential Information, the Participant would inevitably use and/or disclose that Confidential Information in breach of his confidentiality and non-disclosure obligations if the Participant worked in certain capacities or engaged in certain activities for a period of time following his employment with the Company, specifically in a position that involves (i) responsibility and decision-making authority or input at the executive level regarding any subject or responsibility, (ii) decision-making responsibility or input at any management level in the Participant&#8217;s individual area of assignment with the Company, or (iii) responsibility and decision-making authority or input that otherwise allows the use of the Confidential Information (collectively referred to as the &#8220;Restricted Occupation&#8221;).&nbsp;&nbsp;Therefore, except with the prior written consent of the Company, during the term of this letter agreement, the Participant agrees not to be employed by, consult for or otherwise act on behalf of any person or entity in any capacity in which he would be involved, directly or indirectly, in a Restricted Occupation.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Participant acknowledges that this commitment is intended to protect the Confidential Information and is not intended to be applied or interpreted as a covenant against competition.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Georgia;font-size:10pt;">
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-right:7.69%;text-indent:7.69%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Participant further agrees that during the term of this letter agreement, the Participant will not, directly or indirectly on behalf of a person or entity or otherwise, (</font><font style="color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">i</font><font style="color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">) solicit any of the established customers of the Company or attempt to induce any of the established customers of the Company to cease doing business with the Company, or (ii) solicit any of the employees of the Company to cease employment with the Company.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:8pt;margin-top:0pt;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;text-indent:7.69%;">Notwithstanding the foregoing, nothing in this letter agreement is intended to conflict with the Defend Trade Secrets Act or create liability for disclosures of trade secrets that are expressly allowed by that statute. In particular, under the Defend Trade Secrets Act, the Participant will not be held criminally or civilly liable under any federal or state trade secret law for the disclosure of a trade secret of the Company that is made (i) in confidence to a government official or to the Participant&#8217;s attorney solely for the purpose of reporting or investigating a suspected violation of law or (ii) in a complaint or other document that is filed under seal in a proceeding. In addition, if the Participant files a lawsuit for retaliation by the Company for reporting a suspected violation of law, the Participant may disclose the trade secret to the Participant&#8217;s attorney and use the trade secret information in the court proceeding if the Participant files any document containing the trade secret under seal and does not otherwise disclose the trade secret, except pursuant to court order. Further, nothing in this letter agreement or any other agreement or arrangement with the Company shall prohibit or restrict the Participant from making any voluntary disclosure of information or documents pertaining to violations of law to any governmental agency or legislative body, any self-regulatory organization, or the Legal Department of the Company without prior notice to the Company.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-right:7.69%;text-indent:7.69%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;letter-spacing:-0.15pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">This letter agreement shall become effective upon execution by the Participant and the Company and shall terminate on March 31, 20___.&nbsp;&nbsp;<font style="font-weight:bold;">[Note: Insert the year of the next scheduled Vesting Date of an Installment.&nbsp;&nbsp;For example, if the letter agreement is executed on March 31, 2018, the termination date inserted in the preceding sentence would be March 31, 2019.]</font></p>

<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Calibri;letter-spacing:-0.15pt;font-size:12pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">2017 LONG-TERM INCENTIVE PLAN</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Calibri;font-size:12pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">PERFORMANCE SHARE UNIT AGREEMENT</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">THIS PERFORMANCE SHARE UNIT AWARD AGREEMENT (this &#8220;Award Agreement&#8221;) is entered into as of <font style="font-weight:bold;color:#1F497D;">#GrantDate#</font> (the &#8220;Date of Grant&#8221;), by and between Devon Energy Corporation, a Delaware corporation (the &#8220;Company&#8221;), and <font style="font-weight:bold;color:#1F497D;">#ParticipantName#</font> (the &#8220;Participant&#8221;);</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">W I T N E S S E T H:</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">WHEREAS, the Devon Energy Corporation 2017 Long-Term Incentive Plan (the &#8220;Plan&#8221;) permits the grant of Performance Units (hereinafter referred to as &#8220;Performance Share Units&#8221;) to employees, officers and non-employee directors of the Company and its Subsidiaries and Affiliated Entities, in accordance with the terms and provisions of the Plan; and</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">WHEREAS, in connection with the Participant&#8217;s employment with the Company, the Company desires to award to the Participant <font style="font-weight:bold;color:#1F497D;">#QuantityGranted#</font> Performance Share Units subject to the terms and conditions of this Award Agreement and the Plan; and</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">WHEREAS, the Performance Share Units granted pursuant to this Award Agreement shall vest based on the following two-step process: (i) first, the maximum number of Performance Share Units in which Participant can vest shall be calculated based on the attainment and certification of the Performance Goal described on Schedule A as of the end of the Performance Period, (ii) then, if the value (based on the fair market value of a share of Common Stock on the last day of the Performance Period) of the aggregate number of Performance Share Units calculated under clause (i) exceeds the Payout Value Limit described on Schedule A, the number of Performance Share Units calculated under clause (i) shall be reduced so that the value (based on the fair market value of a share of Common Stock on the last day of the Performance Period) of the total number of vested Performance Share Units is equal to the Payout Value Limit; and</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises and the mutual promises and covenants herein contained, the Participant and the Company agree as follows:</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">1.</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">The Plan</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Plan, a copy of which is attached hereto, is hereby incorporated by reference herein and made a part hereof for all purposes, and when taken with this Award Agreement shall govern the rights of the Participant and the Company with respect to the Award.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">2.</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">Grant of Award</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company hereby grants to the Participant a target award (the &#8220;Award&#8221;) of </font><font style="font-weight:bold;color:#1F497D;font-size:11pt;">#QuantityGranted#</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;"> Performance Share Units, on the terms and conditions set forth herein and in the Plan. </font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;color:#000000;"> </font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">Each Performance Share Unit that vests entitles the Participant to one share of Common Stock.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">3.</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">Terms of Award</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(a)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">Performance Share Unit Account</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company shall establish a bookkeeping account on its records for the Participant and shall credit the Participant&#8217;s Performance Share Units to the bookkeeping account.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Georgia;font-size:10pt;">

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="text-decoration:none;Background-color:#auto;">(b)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">General Vesting Terms</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;Except as provided in this Section 3, the number of Performance Share Units which actually vest under this Agreement shall be determined pursuant to the following two-step process: (</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">i</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">) first, the maximum number of Performance Share Units in which the Participant can vest shall be calculated based on the attainment and certification of the Performance Goal described on Schedule A as of the end of the Performance Period, (ii) then, if the value (based on the fair market value of a share of Common Stock on the last day of the Performance Period) of the aggregate number of Performance Share Units calculated under clause (</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">i</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">) exceeds the Payout Value Limit described on Schedule A, the number of Units calculated under clause (</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">i</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">) shall be reduced so that the value (based on the fair market value of a share of Common Stock on the last day of the Performance Period) of the total number of vested Performance Share Units is equal to the Payout Value Limit.&nbsp;&nbsp;Any Performance Share Units that do not vest under the foregoing two-step process as of the end of the Performance Period shall be forfeited as of the end of the Performance Period. Except as specifically provided below in this Section 3, in the event of a termination of the Participant&#8217;s employment prior to the end of the Performance Period, all unvested Performance Share Units will be immediately forfeited.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(c)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">If a Participant&#8217;s Date of Termination occurs by reason of disability or other special circumstances (as determined by the Committee), and the Committee determines, in its sole and absolute discretion, that the Performance Share Units shall continue to vest following the Participant&#8217;s Date of Termination, the Participant shall vest in the maximum number of Performance Share Units in which the Participant could vest, based on the two-step process described in Section 3(b), as if the Participant remained in the employ of the Company through the end of the Performance Period.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(d)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">If the Participant is Post-Retirement Vesting Eligible, the Participant shall vest in the maximum number of Performance Share Units in which the Participant could vest, based on the two-step process described in Section 3(b), as if the Participant remained in the employ of the Company through the end of the Performance Period, provided that, such continued vesting shall be subject to the satisfaction of the conditions in Section 13, and the Participant shall only be eligible to vest in accordance with the two-step process described in Section 3(b) with respect to the percentage of unvested Performance Share Units set forth in the table below.</font></p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(e)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">Performance Share Units shall continue to vest and the Participant shall vest in the maximum number of Performance Share Units in which the Participant could vest, based on the two-step process described in Section 3(b), as if the Participant remained in the employ of the Company through the end of the Performance Period</font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;color:#000000;"> </font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">following the Participant&#8217;s Date of Termination that occurs under circumstances in which the Participant is entitled to a severance payment from the Company, a Subsidiary, or an Affiliated Entity under (A) the Participant&#8217;s employment agreement or severance agreement with the Company due to a termination of the Participant&#8217;s employment by the Company without &#8220;cause&#8221; or </font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Georgia;font-size:10pt;">
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">by the Participant for &#8220;good reason&#8221; in accordance with the Participant&#8217;s employment agreement or severance agreement or (B) the Devon Energy Corporation Severance Plan, provided that for a severance related termination, the Participant </font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">timely </font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">signs and returns to the Company a release of claims against the Company in a form prepared by the Company (the &#8220;Release&#8221;) and such Release becomes effective.&nbsp;&nbsp;If the Participant fails to </font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">timely </font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">sign and return the Release to the Company or revokes the Release prior to the date the Release becomes effective, the Performance Share Units (and Dividend Equivalents) subject to this Award Agreement shall be forfeited.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">If (1) the Award is eligible for vesting under the circumstances described in sub-sections (d) or (e) (other than in connection with a Change in Control Event) above, and (2) the Participant&#8217;s Date of Termination occurs before the one-year anniversary of the Date of Grant, then, notwithstanding such provisions in sub-sections (d) and (e) above, the number of Performance Share Units that would have otherwise vested pursuant to such provisions will be pro-rated based on the number of days from the Date of Grant to the Date of Termination out of 365.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(f)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">A Participant shall become fully and immediately vested in the Award at the target level of performance for the Performance Period in the event of the Participant&#8217;s death.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(g)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">Voting Rights and Dividend Equivalents</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Participant shall not have any voting rights with respect to the Performance Share Units.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Participant shall be credited with dividend equivalents (&#8220;Dividend Equivalents&#8221;) with respect to each outstanding Performance Share Unit to the extent that any dividends or other distributions (in cash or other property) are declared and/or paid with respect to the shares of Common Stock after the commencement of the Performance Period (other than distributions pursuant to a share split, for which an adjustment shall be made as described in Section 12.1 of the Plan).&nbsp;&nbsp;Dividend Equivalents shall be credited to the bookkeeping account established on the records of the Company for the Participant and will vest subject to the same conditions as are applicable to the underlying Performance Share Units, and Dividend Equivalents will be paid in cash to the Participant reasonably promptly following such vesting (but in no event later than March 15 of the calendar year following the year in which such vesting occurs).&nbsp;&nbsp;Accordingly, Dividend Equivalents shall be forfeited to the extent that the Performance Share Units do not vest and are forfeited or cancelled.&nbsp;&nbsp;No interest shall be credited on Dividend Equivalents.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(h)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">Conversion of Performance Share Units; Delivery of Performance Share Units</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(i)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="font-family:Calibri;color:#000000;">Except in the event of the Participant&#8217;s death or the occurrence of certain Change in Control Events as described under the Plan, the Committee shall, within a reasonably practicable time following the last day of the Performance Period, certify the extent, if any, to which the Performance Goal has been achieved with respect to the Performance Period and the number of Performance Share Units, if any, earned upon attainment of the Performance Goal, as reduced by the Payout Value Limit, if applicable.&nbsp;&nbsp;Such certification shall be final, conclusive and binding on the Participant, and on all other persons, to the maximum extent permitted by law.&nbsp;&nbsp;Payment in respect of vested Performance Share Units shall be made promptly following the Committee&#8217;s certification of the attainment of the Performance Goal and the determination of the number of vested Performance Share Units, but in any event, no later than March 15 of the year following the year in which the Performance Period ends.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(ii)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="font-family:Calibri;color:#000000;">In the event of the Participant&#8217;s death, payment in respect of earned and vested Performance Share Units shall be made as soon as reasonably practicable thereafter.</font></p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="text-decoration:none;Background-color:#auto;">(iii)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="font-family:Calibri;color:#000000;">Notwithstanding any provision of this Award Agreement to the contrary, in no event shall the timing of the Participant&#8217;s execution of the Compliance Certificate, directly or indirectly, result in the Participant designating the calendar year of payment, and if a payment that is subject to execution of the Compliance Certificate could be made in more than one taxable year, payment shall be made in the later taxable year.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(iv)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="font-family:Calibri;color:#000000;">All payments in respect of earned and vested Performance Share Units shall be made in freely transferable shares of Common Stock.&nbsp;&nbsp;No fractional shares of Common Stock shall be issued pursuant to this Award, and any fractional share resulting from any calculation made in accordance with the terms of this Award Agreement shall be rounded down to the next whole share.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">4.</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">Employment</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;Nothing in the Plan or in this Award Agreement shall confer upon the Participant any right to continue in the employ of the Company or any of its Subsidiaries or Affiliated Entities, or interfere in any way with the right to terminate the Participant&#8217;s employment at any time.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">5.</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">Non-transferability of Award</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Participant shall not have the right to sell, assign, transfer, convey, dispose, pledge, hypothecate, burden, encumber or charge any Performance Share Unit or any interest therein in any manner whatsoever.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">6.</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">Notices</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;All notices or other communications relating to the Plan and this Agreement as it relates to the Participant shall be in writing and shall be delivered personally or mailed (U.S. mail) by the Company to the Participant at the then current address as maintained by the Company or such other address as the Participant may advise the Company in writing.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">7.</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">Binding Effect and Governing Law</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;This Award Agreement shall be (i) binding upon and inure to the benefit of the parties hereto and their respective heirs, successors and assigns except as may be limited by the Plan, and (ii) governed by and construed under the laws of the State of Delaware.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">8.</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">Company Policies</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Participant agrees that the Award</font><font style="color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;">, and the right to receive and/or retain any vested Performance Share Units or payments covered by this Award,</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;"> will be subject to any applicable clawback or recoupment policies, share trading policies and other policies that may be implemented from time to time by the Company&#8217;s Board of Directors, a duly authorized committee thereof or the Company</font><font style="color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;">, or as required by applicable law or any applicable securities exchange listings standards.</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">&nbsp;&nbsp;By accepting this Award under the Plan, the Participant agrees and acknowledges that the Participant is obligated to cooperate with, and provide any and all assistance necessary to, the Company to recover or recoup any Award or amounts paid under the Plan subject to clawback pursuant to such policy, law or standard.&#160; Such cooperation and assistance shall include, but is not limited to, executing, completing and submitting any documentation necessary to recover or recoup any Award or amounts paid pursuant to this Award.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">9.</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">Withholding</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">. The Company and the Participant shall comply with all federal and state laws and regulations respecting the required withholding, deposit and payment of any income, employment or other taxes relating to the Award (including Dividend Equivalents).&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company shall withhold the employer&#8217;s minimum statutory withholding based upon minimum statutory withholding rates for federal and state purposes, or as otherwise approved by the Committee, including payroll taxes that are applicable to such supplemental taxable income.&nbsp;&nbsp;Any payment of required withholding taxes by the Participant in the form of Common Stock shall not be permitted if it would result in an accounting charge to the Company with respect to such shares used to pay such taxes unless otherwise approved by the Committee.</font></p>

Non-Disclosure Agreement and Compliance Certificate, as applicable, for each year to satisfy the Participant&#8217;s obligations under this Section and similar provisions in the Participant&#8217;s <p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><a name="_DV_C117"></a><a name="_DV_C120"></a><a name="_DV_C122"></a><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(b)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;">Consequences of Failure to Satisfy Vesting Conditions</font><font style="text-decoration:none;font-size:11pt;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;In the event that, the Participant fails to deliver either the respective Non-Disclosure Agreement or Compliance Certificate </font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;"><a name="_DV_C117"></a>on or before the date required</font><font style="text-decoration:none;font-size:11pt;"> for the delivery of such document (such failure, a &#8220;Non-Compliance Event&#8221;), the Participant shall not be entitled to vest in any unvested Performance Share Units </font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;"><a name="_DV_C120"></a>and the unvested Performance Share Units subject to this Award Agreement shall be forfeited.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font><font style="text-decoration:none;font-size:11pt;">The</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;"><a name="_DV_C122"></a> only remedy of the Company for failure to deliver </font><font style="text-decoration:none;font-size:11pt;">a Non&#8209;Disclosure Agreement or a Compliance Certificate</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;"> shall be the Participant&#8217;s failure to vest in, and forfeiture of, any unvested Performance Share Units.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">14.</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">Definitions</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;Words, terms or phrases used in this Award Agreement shall have the meaning set forth in this Section 14.&nbsp;&nbsp;Capitalized terms used in this Award Agreement but not defined herein shall have the meaning designated in the Plan.</font></p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:18pt;margin-top:0pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;letter-spacing:-0.15pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;text-indent:53.85%;">a Delaware corporation</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;letter-spacing:-0.15pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;text-indent:53.85%;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;PARTICIPANT&#8221;<font style="margin-left:252pt;"></font><font style="font-weight:bold;color:#1F497D;">#ParticipantName#</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Georgia;font-size:10pt;">
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="text-decoration:underline;">SCHEDULE A</font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="text-decoration:underline;">PERFORMANCE GOAL, PERFORMANCE PERIOD AND PAYOUT VALUE LIMIT</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">1.</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">Performance Period</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The maximum number of Performance Share Units in which Participant can vest pursuant to the Award shall be calculated based on the Performance Goal over a three-year Performance Period that begins January 1, 2021 and ends December 31, 2023 (the "Performance Period"). </font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">2.</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">Performance Goal</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Performance Goal is based on total shareholder return (&#8220;TSR&#8221;).&nbsp;&nbsp;TSR shall mean the rate of return stockholders receive through stock price changes and the assumed reinvestment of dividends over the Performance Period.&nbsp;&nbsp;Vesting will be based on the Company&#8217;s TSR ranking relative to the TSR ranking of the Peer Companies (identified in Section 3(c) below).&nbsp;&nbsp;At the end of the Performance Period, the TSR for the Company, and for each Peer Company, shall be determined pursuant to the following formula:</font></p>
<div>
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" align="center" style="border-collapse:collapse; width:99.89%;">
<tr>
<td style="width:99.89%;"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" >
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:0pt;;text-indent:0pt;;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">TSR = <font style="text-decoration:underline;">(Closing Average Share Value &#8211; Opening Average Share Value) + Reinvested Dividends</font></p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" >
<p style="margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:0pt;;text-indent:0pt;;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Opening Average Share Value</p></td>
</tr>
</table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The result shall be rounded to the nearest hundredth of one percent (.01%).</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(a)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">The term &#8220;Closing Average Share Value&#8221; means the average value of the common stock for the 30 trading days ending on the last day of the Performance Period, which shall be calculated as follows: (i) determine the closing price of the common stock on each trading date during 30-day period and (ii) average the amounts so determined for the 30-day period.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(b)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">The term &#8220;Opening Average Share Value&#8221; means the average value of the common stock for the 30 trading days preceding the start of the Performance Period, which shall be calculated as follows: (i) determine the closing price of the common stock on each trading date during the 30-day period and (ii) average the amounts so determined for the 30-day period.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(c)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">&#8220;Reinvested Dividends&#8221; shall be calculated by multiplying (i) the aggregate number of shares (including fractional shares) that could have been purchased during the Performance Period had each cash dividend paid on a single share during that period been immediately reinvested in additional shares (or fractional shares) at the closing selling price per share on the applicable ex-dividend date by (ii) the Closing Average Share Value.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(d)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">Each of the foregoing amounts shall be equitably adjusted for stock splits, stock dividends, recapitalizations and other similar events affecting the shares in question without the issuer&#8217;s receipt of consideration.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">3.</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">Vesting Schedule</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Performance Share Units will vest pursuant to the Award, subject to application of the Payout Value Limit described in Section 4 below, based on the Company&#8217;s relative TSR ranking in respect of the Performance Period as compared to the TSR ranking of the Peer Companies, in accordance with the following schedule:</font></p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(a)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">In the event TSR is positive for the Performance Period, the maximum number of Performance Share Units that can vest for the Performance Period may range from 0% to 200% of the target Award, with the actual percentage to be determined on the basis of the percentile level at which the Committee certifies that the Performance Goal has been attained in relation to the corresponding Performance Goal for Peer Companies for the Performance Period; provided however, that the maximum number of Performance Share Units that may become earned and vested during such Performance Period will be calculated as follows: </font><font style="font-weight:bold;color:#1F497D;font-size:11pt;">#QuantityGranted#</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;"> x 200%.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Committee retains sole discretion to reduce the vesting percentage (and thus the maximum number of Performance Share Units that may vest), including reduction to zero, without regard to the performance of the Company&#8217;s TSR relative to the TSR of the Peer Companies.&nbsp;&nbsp;In addition, vesting of Performance Share Units shall be subject to the Payout Value Limit described in Section 4 below.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(b)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">In the event the Company&#8217;s TSR is negative for the Performance Period, the maximum number of Performance Share Units that can vest for the Performance Period may range from 0% to 100% of the target Award, with the actual percentage to be determined on the basis of the percentile level at which the Committee certifies that the Performance Goal has been attained in relation to the corresponding Performance Goal for Peer Companies for the Performance Period; provided however, that the maximum number of Performance Share Units that may become earned and vested during such Performance Period will be calculated as follows: </font><font style="font-weight:bold;color:#1F497D;font-size:11pt;">#QuantityGranted#</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;"> x 100%.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Committee retains sole discretion to reduce the vesting percentage (and thus the maximum number of Performance Share Units that may vest), including reduction to zero, without regard to the performance of the Company&#8217;s TSR relative to the TSR of the Peer Companies.&nbsp;&nbsp;In addition, vesting of Performance Share Units shall be subject to the Payout Value Limit described in Section 4 below.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(c)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">If the Company&#8217;s final TSR value is equal to the TSR value of a Peer Company, the Committee shall assign the Company the higher ranking.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(d)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">In addition to the Company, the Peer Companies are Apache Corporation, Cabot Oil &amp; Gas Corporation, Cimarex Energy Co., ConocoPhillips, Continental Resources, Inc., Diamondback Energy, Inc., EOG Resources, Inc., Marathon Oil Corporation, Ovintiv Inc., Pioneer Natural Resources Company, and the S&amp;P Midcap 400 Index.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(e)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">The Peer Companies will be subject to change as follows:</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Georgia;font-size:10pt;">
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:8pt;">&nbsp;</p>&nbsp;</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(i)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="font-family:Calibri;color:#000000;">In the event of a merger, acquisition or business combination transaction of a Peer Company, in which the Peer Company is the surviving entity and remains publicly traded, the surviving entity shall remain a Peer Company.&nbsp;&nbsp;Any entity involved in the transaction that is not the surviving company shall no longer be a Peer Company. </font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:15.38%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:11pt;font-family:Trebuchet MS;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">(ii)</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="font-family:Calibri;color:#000000;">If a Peer Company ceases to be a publicly traded company at any time during the Performance Period, for any reason, such company shall remain a Peer Company but shall be deemed to have a TSR of negative 100% (-100%).</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">4.</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">Reduction; Pro-rata vesting</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;If the value (based on the fair market value of a share of Common Stock on the last day of the Performance Period) of the aggregate number of Performance Share Units that vest pursuant to the Award based on Sections 1-3 of this Schedule A exceeds the Payout Value Limit, then the maximum number of vested Performance Share Units calculated under Sections 1-3 of this Schedule A shall be reduced so that the value (based on the fair market value of a share of Common Stock on the last day of the Performance Period) of the total number of Performance Share Units that vest pursuant to the Award is equal to the Payout Value Limit.&nbsp;&nbsp;The &#8220;Payout Value Limit&#8221; shall be equal to the product of (a) the fair market value of a share of Common Stock on the first day of the Performance Period, times (b) the target number of Units subject to the Award, times (c) four.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;color:#0D0D0D;font-size:11pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In addition, in the event the pro-ration terms of Section 3(e) of the Award Agreement apply, then the number of Performance Share Units that vest pursuant to the Award based on Sections 1-3 of this Schedule A will be pro-rated based on the number of days from the Date of Grant to the Date of Termination out of 365. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#auto;font-size:10pt;font-family:Calibri;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;letter-spacing:0pt;"><font style="Background-color:#auto;text-decoration:none;">5.</font><font style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Georgia;margin-left:36pt;color:#000000;"></font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">General Vesting Terms</font><font style="font-size:11pt;color:#000000;">.&nbsp;&nbsp;Any fractional Performance Share Unit resulting from the vesting of the Performance Share Units in accordance with the Award Agreement shall be rounded down to the nearest whole number.&nbsp;&nbsp;Any portion of the Performance Share Units that does not vest as of the end of the Performance Period shall be forfeited as of the end of the Performance Period.</font></p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:7.69%;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Calibri;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Participant agrees that, due to his access to the Confidential Information, the Participant would inevitably use and/or disclose that Confidential Information in breach of his confidentiality and non-disclosure obligations if the Participant worked in certain capacities or engaged in certain activities for a period of time following his employment with the Company, specifically in a position that involves (i) responsibility and decision-making authority or input at the executive level regarding any subject or responsibility, (ii) decision-making responsibility or input at any management level in the Participant&#8217;s individual area of assignment with the Company, or (iii) responsibility and decision-making authority or input that otherwise allows the use of the Confidential Information (collectively referred to as the &#8220;Restricted Occupation&#8221;).&nbsp;&nbsp;Therefore, except with the prior written consent of the Company, during the term of this letter agreement, the Participant agrees not to be employed by, consult for or otherwise act on behalf of any person or entity in any capacity in which he would be involved, directly or indirectly, in a Restricted Occupation.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Participant acknowledges that this commitment is intended to protect the Confidential Information and is not intended to be applied or interpreted as a covenant against competition.</p>

In particular, under the Defend Trade Secrets Act, the Participant will not be held criminally or civilly liable under any federal or state trade secret law for the disclosure of a trade secret of the Company that is made (i) in confidence to a government official or to the Participant&#8217;s attorney solely for the purpose of reporting or investigating a suspected violation of law or (ii) in a complaint or other document that is filed under seal in a proceeding. In addition, if the Participant files a lawsuit for retaliation by the Company for reporting a suspected violation of law, the Participant may disclose the trade secret to the Participant&#8217;s attorney and use the trade secret information in the court proceeding if the Participant files any document containing the trade secret under seal and does not otherwise disclose the trade secret, except pursuant to court order. Further, nothing in this letter agreement or any other agreement or arrangement with the Company shall prohibit or restrict the Participant from making any voluntary disclosure of information or documents pertaining to violations of law to any governmental agency or legislative body, any self-regulatory organization, or the Legal Department of the Company without prior notice to the Company.</p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:right;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Exhibit 31.1</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">CERTIFICATION PURSUANT TO</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">RULE 13a-14(a)/15d-14(a),</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">AS ADOPTED PURSUANT TO</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">SECTION 302 OF THE SARBANES-OXLEY ACT OF 2002</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">I, Richard E. Muncrief, certify that:</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">1. &#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;I have reviewed this quarterly report on Form 10-Q of Devon Energy Corporation;</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">2. &#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Based on my knowledge, this report does not contain any untrue statement of a material fact or omit to state a material fact necessary to make the statements made, in light of the circumstances under which such statements were made, not misleading with respect to the period covered by this report;</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">3. &#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Based on my knowledge, the financial statements, and other financial information included in this report, fairly present in all material respects the financial condition, results of operations and cash flows of the registrant as of, and for, the periods presented in this report;</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">4. &#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;The registrant&#8217;s other certifying officer and I are responsible for establishing and maintaining disclosure controls and procedures (as defined in Exchange Act Rules 13a-15(e) and 15d-15(e)) and internal control over financial reporting (as defined in Exchange Act Rules 13a-15(f) and 15d-15(f)) for the registrant and have:</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:4.54%;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">a) designed such disclosure controls and procedures, or caused such disclosure controls and procedures to be designed under our supervision, to ensure that material information relating to the registrant, including its consolidated subsidiaries, is made known to us by others within those entities, particularly during the period in which this report is being prepared;</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:4.54%;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">b) designed such internal control over financial reporting, or caused such internal control over financial reporting to be designed under our supervision, to provide reasonable assurance regarding the reliability of financial reporting and the preparation of financial statements for external purposes in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles;</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:4.54%;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">c) evaluated the effectiveness of the registrant&#8217;s disclosure controls and procedures and presented in this report our conclusions about the effectiveness of the disclosure controls and procedures, as of the end of the period covered by this report based on such evaluation; and</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:4.54%;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">d) disclosed in this report any change in the registrant&#8217;s internal control over financial reporting that occurred during the registrant&#8217;s most recent fiscal quarter (the registrant&#8217;s fourth fiscal quarter in the case of an annual report) that has materially affected, or is reasonably likely to materially affect, the registrant&#8217;s internal control over financial reporting; and</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">5. &#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;The registrant&#8217;s other certifying officer and I have disclosed, based on our most recent evaluation of internal control over financial reporting, to the registrant&#8217;s auditors and the audit committee of registrant&#8217;s board of directors (or persons performing the equivalent functions):</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:4.54%;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">a) all significant deficiencies and material weaknesses in the design or operation of internal control over financial reporting which are reasonably likely to adversely affect the registrant&#8217;s ability to record, process, summarize and report financial information; and</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:4.54%;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">b) any fraud, whether or not material, that involves management or other employees who have a significant role in the registrant&#8217;s internal control over financial reporting.</p>
